copy.tagline: 追踪用户行为并分析产品数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为产品接入用户行为分析和事件追踪。
copy.tagline_en: Track user behavior and analyze product data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate user behavior analytics and event tracking into your product.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你编写 PostHog 事件追踪代码，包括用户识别、分组分析和隐私合规模式。它会指导你使用正确的命名规则，并确保在用户登录/登出时正确处理 identify 和 reset。
howto.when: 当你询问如何实现产品分析、追踪用户行为、设置漏斗或配置符合 GDPR 的追踪时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个用户注册成功的事件追踪代码。
如何在 React 中设置 PostHog 用户识别？
PostHog 的 GDPR 合规模式怎么配置？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you write PostHog event tracking code, including user identification, group analytics, and privacy-compliant patterns. It guides you on naming conventions and ensures proper identify/reset handling on login/logout.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about implementing product analytics, tracking user behavior, setting up funnels, or configuring GDPR-compliant tracking.

say_en.text: Write a tracking code for user registration success event.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an example with identify and capture.

say_en.text: How to set up PostHog user identification in React?
say_en.note: Claude will provide usePostHog hook and identify usage.

say_en.text: How to configure PostHog GDPR compliance mode?
say_en.note: Claude will explain cookieless_mode and opt_in/out methods.
